start: ^Good day! The market moves faster than news. People are saying strange things. What draws you to my stall? Have you heard the rumors of the miracles that Jesus has performed.
^I'm looking for information about the Galilean.
^Have you seen any unusual activity in the courts?
galilean_rumors: ^People are saying He healed a blind man at Bethesda. Others say He raised someone from the dead in Bethany. The Pharisees are trying to keep it quiet, but you can't stop a story like that from spreading. Who is he that can raise the dead?
court_rumors: ^The Temple courts have been a whirlwind for three days running. Questions, answers, more questions — and the Galilean keeps trapping them with His words. They tried to trap him with thier questions. Asking him who we should pay taxes to - the "emperor" or "Caesar. (Matthew 22:15-22.) He answers “Give therefore to the emperor the things that are the emperor’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
priest_response: ^The chief priests and Pharisees met in emergency session after Lazarus. They're planning something. I don't know what, but when the Sanhedrin starts meeting before dawn, it's never good for anyone.
closing: ^Keep your eyes open. The coin-changers' guild has informants everywhere — and three days ago I saw one of them slipping into the High Priest's courtyard with a leather pouch full of silver.
